Package uno.v1.engine

Class EventLogger

java.lang.Object
uno.v1.engine.EventLogger
public class EventLogger extends Object
Responsible for printing the structured event log to standard output.

All output lines follow the specification in Section 1.4 of the project description. Only this class writes to stdout, keeping output formatting centralised.
